column1: COMMON SETTINGS (every table, from the CloudFormation template)
TABLE RoommateStatus-main - accounts & roommate status (one item per account; id is the normalized lowercase username)
TABLE RoommateStatus-main-pushsubs - Web Push subscriptions (one item per browser/device; id is sha256(endpoint) so re-saving a device is idempotent)
TABLE RoommateStatus-main-activities - multi-type table, discriminated by itemType. Every content item carries a groupId so feeds stay isolated per household.

column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-main-activities / activity - no itemType. updatedAt absent on legacy rows falls back to createdAt in API projections; liveStartedAt is set only while the activity is live.
TABLE RoommateStatus-main-activities / checklist - itemType "checklist". Archived checklists are hidden from the active feed.
TABLE RoommateStatus-main-activities / request - itemType "request". responses maps an account id to yes / no / maybe; targets not yet answered are absent.

TABLE RoommateStatus-main-activities / comment likes - itemType "commentLike" or "requestCommentLike". Stored as their own small items so a like is a single conditional write. id is deterministic: parentId:commentId:userId. A commentLike sets activityId; a requestCommentLike sets requestId.

TABLE RoommateStatus-main-activities / spotifyJam - itemType "spotifyJam". One singleton item per group; ending the Jam deletes the item, so absent means no active Spotify module. updatedAt equals createdAt for the singleton replacement.

TABLE RoommateStatus-main-shows - TV show tracker (one item per tracked show, watchers embedded). completedAt is absent while a show is active - its absence is what active means. members season & episode are 1-based.

TABLE RoommateStatus-main-groups - households / groups (one item per household). The JoinCodeIndex GSI (partition key joinCode, ProjectionType ALL) powers join-by-code lookups. The seeded default group is yorkshire / YORKSHIRE.
